description: This file defines the CustomFieldService class in the OrangeHRM project, providing methods for managing custom fields related to employees, such as generating field keys and getters, extracting field numbers, and managing associated extra data.

classes.name: CustomFieldService
classes.description: Service class for handling operations related to custom employee fields, such as generating field keys, getters, extracting field numbers, and removing extra data associated with custom fields.

methods.name: getCustomFieldDao
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of CustomFieldDao, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: generateGettersByFieldNumbers
methods.description: Generates getter method names for an array of field numbers based on a predefined prefix.

methods.name: generateFieldKeyByFieldId
methods.description: Creates a field key string like 'custom1' for a given field number.

methods.name: generateSetterByFieldKey
methods.description: Generates a setter method name given a field key string.

methods.name: extractFieldNumbersFromFieldKeys
methods.description: Extracts numeric field identifiers from an array of field key strings.

methods.name: deleteRelatedEmployeeCustomFieldsExtraData
methods.description: Removes extra data entries related to a specific custom field ID, updating employees if necessary.

methods.name: getAllFieldsInUse
methods.description: Returns a list of all custom field IDs currently in use (up to 10).
